access.edition_or_version: Translated by Burton Watson (Columbia University Press, 1997)

mechanics.point_of_view: Observing eye; the poet records rather than comments.
mechanics.style_and_devices: Shasei ('sketch from life'): plain observation of fact; juxtaposition of two observed things; rejection of ornamental fantasy.
mechanics.emotional_progression: Feeling is left implicit in selection and juxtaposition; the poem does not state it.
mechanics.imagery: Concrete natural and everyday images; no pathetic fallacy.
mechanics.verification_note: Edition and shasei program confirmed; translation limits noted in the source record.
